visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan Shiba Inu dog wearing a detailed Snow White costume, featuring a blue velvet-like top and a puffy yellow skirt, sits behind a silver laptop on a white marble table. The setting is a brightly lit living room with a beige sofa and a plush dog-head pillow in the background. A cartoon thought bubble with a red heart appears above the dog, and a text overlay identifies her as Nana. (2) The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the laptop screen, showcasing a variety of pet treats, dried meat snacks, and colorful rope toys arranged on a wooden board. Multiple pink heart icons float upwards, visually conveying the dog's excitement and desire for the products. The lighting is focused and warm, highlighting the textures of the food and toys. (3) A man dressed as the Evil Queen, wearing a gold crown and a high-collared blue gown over a black hood, enters from a dark wooden door in the background. He points aggressively at the dog while speaking with an exaggerated, angry facial expression. The dog looks up at him with its mouth open, appearing to react to his sudden and dramatic presence. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the dog in various working roles: first as a delivery dog wearing a pink hooded sweatshirt next to paper bags, then as an office assistant sitting in a gaming chair in front of a computer. The backgrounds vary from a hallway to a tech-filled room with Pikachu plushies, indicating a shift in locations and narrative progression. (5) The video transitions to a screen recording of the Shopee mobile application, demonstrating the Shopee Short Video feature. The interface shows various video thumbnails, product listings with prices, and navigation buttons. A hand is seen interacting with the screen, scrolling through the app's referral and commission settings, providing a clear tutorial-like visual guide. (6) In the final scene, the man and the dog are on a bed; the man is now smiling and holding a smartphone, showing the app to the dog. The dog looks at the screen and then at the man, who affectionately pets its head. The lighting is soft and domestic, concluding the story on a warm and humorous note as they both look towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a cheerful, high-tempo BGM featuring bright synthesizer plucks and a steady, rhythmic beat around 128 BPM. A sharp, enthusiastic dog bark is heard, followed immediately by a stylized Wow vocal sound effect and a high-pitched notification chime. The overall acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a professional studio recording with minimal ambient noise. (2) A distinct cha-ching cash register sound effect signals a transition. A man's voice enters, utilizing a dramatic, high-arousal Evil Queen persona; his pitch is slightly elevated, and his delivery is sharp and authoritative. The BGM continues in the background but at a slightly lower volume to allow the dialogue to remain the primary auditory signal. (3) The acoustic texture shifts as a deeper, gravelly, and electronically filtered voice represents the magic mirror dinosaur character. This voice has a slower speech rate and a more menacing, low-frequency contour. A crisp, high-transient crunch sound effect of biting an apple is prominently featured, followed by a whimsical, short musical sting that emphasizes the comedic tone. (4) A transition into a commercial-style segment occurs, marked by an upbeat, energetic pop-style BGM with a strong, driving four-on-the-floor beat. A clear, professional male narrator delivers a high-density sales pitch with enthusiastic prosody and perfectly enunciated Traditional Chinese. Sound effects like pop and ding are layered over the speech to highlight specific on-screen app features. (5) The video concludes with the return of the initial playful BGM. The man's voice softens into a friendly, satisfied tone, interacting with the dog, whose panting and light whining sounds are audible. The BGM fades out gradually with a standard audio fade-out, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio and studio-grade clarity throughout the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video uses a humorous skit involving a Shiba Inu and a man in costume to promote Shopee's short video affiliate program. It begins with a relatable comedic scenario of overspending, leads into a 'magic' solution provided by a talking dinosaur, and concludes with a detailed tutorial on how users can earn passive income by uploading videos to Shopee.
